scope: advisory two-role scrutiny of bounded synthetic MCP Toolbox results

advisory.largest_remaining_gap: Adversarial coverage is one input class: 6 of 11 checks are the identical injection_or_invalid_name check, and get_safe_setting has zero adversarial coverage. All 11 passes validate only malformed/invalid arguments to 3 allowlisted tools; semantically valid but hostile arguments (e.g., unqualified names resolved via a manipulated search_path, EXPLAIN ANALYZE on attacker-chosen statements) are untested, and the shadow-catalog control used an isolated fake table rather than a real schema-resolution path.
advisory.next_independent_oracle: Drive the real MCP server with semantically valid adversarial arguments: set a role-controlled search_path pointing at an attacker schema and submit unqualified names plus EXPLAIN ANALYZE through explain_planner/explain_volatile, asserting the shadow catalog is still ignored, the volatile function does not execute, and revoke_execute still denies — under the same timeout and no-network constraints.

interpretation: Model roles are advisory, not independent security test or oracle
